title: Compaction
caption: The same chat run on to its compaction at step 24, with the attention each message gets.

readme.heading: Read me
readme.shows: The chat, the window and the attention card, from step 24 of the summer party. The chat has just been compacted into a summary.
readme.tryit: Drag the timeline back to step 21, then forward to 24. Hover a block to light its row in the attention list. Switch on Technical to see the unit values beside the bars.
readme.notice: At step 21 the Budget message sits in the faded middle. After the compaction the summary takes the largest share of attention.
